rows.ARS:
Light pink Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Happy Silver Wedding
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2013).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2013 as 'Happy Silver Wedding'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink. Medium, double (17-25 petals), in large clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
